mapper.insert: INSERT INTO email_template ( template_name, template_type, subject, content, status, create_time, create_user_id, create_user_name, update_time, update_user_id, update_user_name ) VALUES ( #{templateName}, #{templateType}, #{subject}, #{content}, #{status}, #{createTime}, #{createUserId}, #{createUserName}, #{updateTime}, #{updateUserId}, #{updateUserName} )
mapper.update: UPDATE email_template SET template_name = #{templateName}, template_type = #{templateType}, subject = #{subject}, content = #{content}, status = #{status}, update_time = #{updateTime}, update_user_id = #{updateUserId}, update_user_name = #{updateUserName} WHERE template_id = #{templateId}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM email_template ORDER BY create_time DESC
SELECT * FROM email_template WHERE template_type = #{templateType} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
SELECT * FROM email_template WHERE status = #{status} ORDER BY create_time DESC
